verdict.rationale: Svelte ships first-party state management inside the framework itself. The docs cover `$state`, `$derived`, `$state.raw` and `$state` in class fields, and say `.svelte.js`/`.svelte.ts` modules let you share reactive state across your app. A hands-on user also reports that Svelte Stores and the Context system work well for sharing state. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the stores API (only a community mention here), any dedicated app-wide store library with devtools or patterns, and deeper independent corroboration of large-app state management.
